title: Release metadata
description: data/meta.json: label and handwritten note for the NEXT release. The maintainer updates it in the release pull request.

label.description: Season label of the next pack, for example "Y11S3.0".

minApp.description: Lowest app versionCode that can read the pack. Raise it only when the pack uses something older apps do not understand.

note.description: Optional maintainer note shown above the automatic change list. English required when present.
